name: -16 AN 90 Degree Male ORB Swivel Union Fitting
title: -16 AN 90 Degree Male ORB Swivel Union Fitting
description:
The -16 AN 90 Degree Male ORB Swivel Union Fitting is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings 90 Degree Male ORB Swivel Union Fittings are precision CNC-machined to connect male O-Ring Boss (ORB) ports while providing a compact 90-degree routing solution for fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, hydraulic, and power steering systems. The swivel design allows for easy clocking and precise alignment, ensuring a secure, leak-free seal without compromising installation flexibility.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: Premium high-grade construction with corrosion-resistant coating.
• Flow Configuration: 90° mandrel-bent profile for high velocity in tight engine bays.
• Sealing Type: Viton O-Ring Boss (ORB) positive seal to prevent thread sealant contamination.
